text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—And into the home stretch!! The home 
stretch of the Japanese Derby!! Up the 
hill they charge! Which Umamusume will 
seize victory!?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (――Fulfill my duty.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (――Live up to their trust.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (Yes, I swore it. That's why————)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Now is the time to burn everything to 
ashes.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaahhh!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet! Tanino Gimlet!! Tanino 
Gimlet—!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: It's Tanino Gimlet――!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Gimlet wins the Derby!! Tanino Gimlet was 
simply too strong!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Incredible...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap, holy crap, holy CRAP!!! What 
was that, even...?! That was way too 
cool!!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Me too, I'm gonna...! I'm definitely 
gonna run like that too...!! In this very 
Derby...!!!"

text_block_list.name: Gimlet Fan A
text_block_list.text:
UWOOOH!! Gimlet is the strongestーー!! 
Congratulations, God of Destructionーー!

text_block_list.name: Gimlet Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That was the absolute best------!! Truly, 
truly, congratulations!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...The proof is complete.
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(...In that moment, Gimlet showed an 
immense power, far greater than ever 
before...)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(That sensational run... created this 
frenzy... and—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(...Creating such feverish excitement is 
surely something I cannot do—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(A sight completely unlike anything of 
mine... one that only Gimlet could ever 
create—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (However—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...I will run my own race. —Next.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S was so close. Still... 
she's truly the same as always, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Doesn't she feel any frustration? It's 
kind of hard to tell with her."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if my knees get stained with 
dirt, ...even if I'm never granted a 
rematch."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Kris S-san... never changes.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fixing my gaze on what lies ahead... 
Simply to do what must be done... With an 
unchanging, indomitable heart, I rise...—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to become one too. An 
unshakeable "hero" just like you!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And so, the "fateful day" came to an end— 
and our paths were meant to diverge.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ......Gimlet――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Already looking ahead to what's 
next, are you? Good. You still have a 
"future"—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(What is this...? There's something... in 
Gimlet's words...)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And with this, my curtain falls. The seeds 
of the next chaos have been sown, and what 
arrives is a delightful boredom—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I've done enough. —What comes 'after' is 
your era, Kris S."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Wait. What... does that mean?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh— You'll understand in time.

Symboli Kris S returned after finishing 
the fierce battle. Her demeanor, as 
always, remained entirely calm.

However, seeing her remain unchanged like 
that, I find myself feeling relieved—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...Forgive me. I failed... to live up to 
your trust—
choice_data_list:
No, it's a "result" we can learn from for 
next time.

No, it's a "result" we can build on for 
next time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I will definitely make use of this. For 
the next 'result'—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: That's why...—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I'll be counting on you from now on as 
well.

"Just straight ahead. Toward the next 
'result.' With an unwavering pace, I 
resolved to start anew from here...!"
That night—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Autumn, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh— Falling leaves beneath a setting sun. 
Truly fitting for the end.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Yet the world, and time, only moves 
forward. Leaving me behind, along with my 
memories—"

Unheard by anyone, those words simply 
dissolved into the starry sky—
